item.title: Trump Sons Tout a $1 Million Bitcoin Price as Goldman CEO Says He Owns BTC
item.description: Bitcoin Magazine Trump Sons Tout a $1 Million Bitcoin Price as Goldman CEO Says He Owns BTC Eric Trump and Donald Trump Jr. predicted Bitcoin could reach $1 million as Goldman Sachs CEO David Solomon revealed a small personal BTC stake. This post Trump Sons Tout a $1 Million Bitcoin Price as Goldman CEO Says He Owns BTC first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman.

item.title: FutureBit launches Apollo III, U.S.-Engineered Home Bitcoin Miner
item.description: Bitcoin Magazine FutureBit launches Apollo III, U.S.-Engineered Home Bitcoin Miner FutureBit launched the Apollo III today, a new home Bitcoin mining system combining a high-performance miner and a full Bitcoin node in a single desktop device. This post FutureBit launches Apollo III, U.S.-Engineered Home Bitcoin Miner first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman.

item.title: Ledn Sells $188M Bitcoin-Backed Bonds in First-of-Its-Kind Deal
item.description: Bitcoin Magazine Ledn Sells $188M Bitcoin-Backed Bonds in First-of-Its-Kind Deal Crypto lender Ledn Inc. has officially sold $188 million in securitized bonds backed by Bitcoin-linked loans. This post Ledn Sells $188M Bitcoin-Backed Bonds in First-of-Its-Kind Deal first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman.

item.title: Voltage Introduces Revolving Credit Line for Bitcoin Settlement, With USD Repayment
item.description: Bitcoin Magazine Voltage Introduces Revolving Credit Line for Bitcoin Settlement, With USD Repayment Voltage, a Bitcoin infrastructure provider, launched Voltage Credit, a revolving line of credit that lets businesses send payments over Bitcoin rails with instant settlement in U.S. dollars. This post Voltage Introduces Revolving Credit Line for Bitcoin Settlement, With USD Repayment first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman.

item.title: The UAE Has Quietly Built Up a $453 Million Bitcoin Reserve: Arkham
item.description: Bitcoin Magazine The UAE Has Quietly Built Up a $453 Million Bitcoin Reserve: Arkham Arkham says UAE royal-linked bitcoin miners are holding 6,782 BTC worth $453.6 million, sitting on an estimated $344 million unrealized profit while largely keeping their stash untouched. This post The UAE Has Quietly Built Up a $453 Million Bitcoin Reserve: Arkham first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman.

item.title: Bitcoin’s Lightning Network Surpasses $1 Billion in Monthly Volume As Adoption Grows
item.description: Bitcoin Magazine Bitcoin’s Lightning Network Surpasses $1 Billion in Monthly Volume As Adoption Grows Bitcoin’s Lightning Network topped $1.17 billion in November monthly volume across 5.22 million transactions, according to River Financial, which says the milestone reflects growing adoption despite flat price action. This post Bitcoin’s Lightning Network Surpasses $1 Billion in Monthly Volume As Adoption Grows first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman.
